Image2 is STYLE reference only, existing seven clan medallions. initialConcepts.name: A-inlaid-strips
initialConcepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Make a high fidelity game UI concept image, matching attached actual game screenshot navy textile mat, brass wear, full physical L5R card faces and parchment. Reference image is composition/material reference, not literal text to copy. Show TWO full Personality cards side by side, one upright and one bowed rotated90degrees lying flush with mat; each has one partially tucked Follower behind, and a connected navy spear standard at right. Remove external round Force/Chi coins completely. The replacement live numbers must occupy ONLY the existing printed TOP LEFT gold/orange Force rectangle and TOP RIGHT gray Chi rectangle in each card's header strip. No extra space outside card for these two numbers. Preserve the full original card aspect and all face content. On upright card currentForce7 Chi3, standard12. On bowed card currentForce7 Chi3, standard0 (because bowed), NEVER zero its PersonalityForce. Light gray brush font numerals. Show small optional hover reading 'Force 7 · Printed 3 · Modifiers +4' away from card if fits. Landscape, exceptionally polished realistic render matching actual tabletop, close enough to examine header strips. Title only as specified. No unrelated menu, no fake controls. Title: 'A · INLAID STRIPS'. Variant: Use flat rectangular inlays precisely replacing the original two number panels. Worn ochre gold on left; brushed gray metal on right, slim aged frame. The numbers sit cleanly centered in each rectangle. Almost printed into the card, no protruding coins. Most faithful to original.
